# 0025: Uplift agentic engineering through assured compositions

Status: accepted
Type: strategy
Date: 2026-10-22

Request: "do not stop until you have a plan and vision for all of this that is
durably planned out and specified out."

## Context

The owner requests practice catalogs, evidence/data engineering, economical
provider-neutral decisions, investigations/reviews, human interaction, governed
prose and learning loops. Existing foundations cover much of the mechanism;
composition, lifecycle coverage and consumer evidence lag behind package breadth.
0024 preserves shared identity without transferring domain authority. 0004 limits
implementation incubations. The 0011-0014 review date, 2026-10-16, has passed.

## Decision

- Update VISION and scope G9-G14. Adopt the [program](../../designs/agentic-engineering/README.md)
  and its six acceptance specifications as design, not shipped capabilities.
- Keep one practice definition for beneficial patterns and their failure modes;
  Catalog Kit owns composition/identity, Review Kit domain judgment, Test Kit
  execution, Fathom optional source proof, app-kit reusable presentation. Domains
  own applicability, policy floors, identity, storage and effects.
- Compose existing seams before adding foundations. Providers share capability
  contracts, not a lowest-common-denominator feature set or assumed calibration.
- Keep TRACKING, intent goals and their source evidence authoritative. Catalog
  views are derived projections; never add a competing completion ledger.
- Sequence the [work order](../../plans/agentic-engineering-uplift.md): bounded
  practice/data reference first, then portable decision/investigation coverage,
  human/prose integration, and measured transfer. No universal platform build.
- This change is design and an offline assessment. It opens no implementation
  incubation, provider campaign, fleet migration, deployment or new dependency.

## Dated review disposition

0011-0014 retain offline delivery and the explicit live-study deferral. Existing
consumer receipts and this assessment do not establish current model quality or
benefit. Park further experimental expansion until a wave has its named subject,
baseline, maintenance/time/spend bounds and free incubation slot recorded. Existing
APIs remain maintained; no tier demotion or package retirement is implied. Apply
the same maintenance-only disposition to the older prose/lesson review dates.
Review queued admission on 2026-11-21 or next release, whichever comes first.
F5's second-self-auditing-consumer trigger is unproven; owner-sponsored design is
permitted by 0004 but does not establish that trigger or justify a new foundation.

## Alternatives

- Build all proposed packages together: hides missing integration and maintenance
  cost. Wins if: never without independently admitted, bounded work units.
- Adopt a vendor certification as the kit's authority: training coverage is input,
  not an executable architecture standard. Wins if: never as sole authority.
- Universal excellence percentage: masks required failures and unknowns. Wins if:
  a particular non-safety prioritization task validates its declared weighting.
- Central memory/agent platform: adds operational authority without a subscriber.
  Wins if: two consumers cannot meet a measured need through their existing ports.

## Revisit when

A composed pilot cannot preserve a domain law, a second consumer demonstrates a
shared missing contract, two incubations miss review, or a wave cannot establish
its baseline within its admitted budget. No automatic public release or 1.0 decision.
